section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1977
title: 23 Volume of Suicides in States/Union Territories and Metropolitan Cities: The volume of suicides per lakh of population for India as a whole as well as for the States, as a whole was 6.3 and for the Union Territories as a whole it was 8.7. The volume of suicides for Union Territories was higher than the States and the all-India average. Among States, the volume of suicides per lakh of population ranged between 20.3 (for Tripura) to 0.2 (for Jammu & Kashmir). The volume of suicides among the Union Territories ranged between 60.9 (for Pondicherry) to 0.0 (for Lakshadweep).
